# Load Packages
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("sf")
library("units")
library("vegan")
library("iNEXT")
```

# Load Data
```{r}
#Clear environment
rm(list = ls())

#Load in GBIF and site datasets
setwd("/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research")

gbif_raw <- read_tsv("data/0003154-260226173443078.csv") 
sites_raw <- read.csv("data/DUG_data - fall_data.csv", na.strings = c("", " "))
```

Select variables of interest in GBIF dataset
```{r}
gbif <- gbif_raw %>%
    dplyr::select(decimalLatitude,decimalLongitude,coordinateUncertaintyInMeters,year,recordedBy,
                  order,family,genus,species)%>%
    filter(year >= 2020)
```

Assign iNaturalist floral observations in surrounding neighborhood to sites
```{r}
#Convert iNaturalist data to an sf object
#Create buffer distances

#Convert gbif to sf points
sf_data <- st_as_sf(gbif, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326)

#Convert cities.test to sf points
gardens.sf <- st_as_sf(sites_raw, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326)

#Create 45 km buffers around all cities
buffer_distance <- set_units(1000, "m")  # 1 km in meters
gardens.buffer <- st_buffer(gardens.sf, dist = buffer_distance)
```

Assign all observations to a garden site
```{r}
# Perform spatial join: assign gardens to points within buffer
sf_data <- st_join(sf_data, gardens.buffer["site_code"], join = st_within)

# Fill points outside any garden buffer
sf_data$site_code <- sf_data$site_code # Copy joined column


# Convert back to data frame if needed
gbif_data <- as.data.frame(sf_data)

# Check unique city assignments
unique(gbif_data$site_code)

gbif_data <- gbif_data %>% filter(!is.na(site_code))
```

# Extract biodiversity metrics
```{r}
# Prepare GBIF data and convert to wide format
gbif_wide <- gbif_data %>%
  count(site_code,species) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site_code, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# Prepare iNEXT input data
gbif.iNEXTinput <- as.data.frame(gbif_wide[,-1])

# Run iNEXT to find richness data
gbif.iNEXT <- iNEXT(gbif.iNEXTinput, q = 0, datatype = "abundance")

# Extract richness and diversity data
gbif_richness <-  gbif.iNEXT$AsyEst[gbif.iNEXT$AsyEst$Diversity == "Species richness",]
gbif_shannon <-  gbif.iNEXT$AsyEst[gbif.iNEXT$AsyEst$Diversity == "Shannon diversity",]
gbif_simpson <-  gbif.iNEXT$AsyEst[gbif.iNEXT$AsyEst$Diversity == "Simpson diversity",]

# Match site_code to Assemblage
sites_raw$gbif.rich   <- gbif_richness$Estimator[match(sites_raw$site_code, gbif_richness$Assemblage)]
sites_raw$gbif.shannon <- gbif_shannon$Estimator[match(sites_raw$site_code, gbif_shannon$Assemblage)]
sites_raw$gbif.simpson <- gbif_simpson$Estimator[match(sites_raw$site_code, gbif_simpson$Assemblage)]
```

Family Level Data for NMDS 
```{r}
# Prepare GBIF genus level data and convert to wide format
gbif_fam_wide <- gbif_data %>%
  count(site_code,family) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = family, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

#Save dataframe
```{r}
#Site level data with landscape level rarefied GBIF floral data added 
write.csv(sites_raw,"/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research/data/DUG_data - fall_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#Landscape Level iNat data from GBIF wide format
write.csv(gbif_fam_wide,"/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research/data/gbif_fam,_wide.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```
